duties.title: Planning Phase
duties.description: As an Explorer, you start the game by planning your route. Pick the items needed.

duties.title: Game Phase
duties.description: Explorers will typically focus on quickly exploring the map, slaying Faithless and gathering the unique items that they can find.

duties.title: Resolution Phase
duties.description: The outcomes of the actions taken in the Action Phase are determined. Players may gain rewards, suffer consequences, or trigger events based on their actions.
